subject: Request: marketplace one-off concession for CloudBright — Net75 billing & revised rev-share
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: marketplace one-off concession for CloudBright — Net75 billing & revised rev-share

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Following the call with CloudBright this morning, procurement has escalated a few asks that are outside our standard marketplace playbook. They are a strategic mid-market customer (DB-4721) and have committed to a 12-month + 6-month pilot cadence if we can accommodate the following one-off concessions: 

- Move billing terms from Net30 to Net75 (company policy requires extended payment window)
- One-time marketplace listing credit equal to $45k applied over first 3 months (to offset onboarding fees)
- Rev-share carveout: they want 15% of marketplaces revenue to flow to a reseller partner for the first 6 months (our standard is 10% with cap) — they are requesting no cap for pilot
- SLA credit language: 2% service credit if latency SLO missed more than 3x in a 30-day window during pilot

Attached is a short term summary and the rev-share model with rough P&L. Key ask: need exec signoff on Net75 + one-time credit + exception to rev-share cap. Can we get quick approval or list the conditions under which we can approve?

Next steps I'd propose if we approve in principle: 
- Finance/Revenue Ops to confirm margin impact and accounting treatment
- Legal to redline the marketplace listing agreement (we have a draft MDP attached)
- If approved, engage partner ops to register the reseller flow and confirm payout cadence

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4721
Attachments: CloudBright_Marketplace_Term_Summary.pdf, revshare_model.xlsx

Thanks — I captured the call notes in the doc.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Account Director, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: marketplace one-off concession for CloudBright — Net75 billing & revised rev-share

Monica — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Quick thoughts after looking at the revshare_model.xlsx: 

- Net75: operationally doable, but increases DSO and capital exposure. Need explicit approval from Finance (Evelyn) and Sales Ops for the credit holdback / collections mechanism.
- $45k onboarding credit: acceptable as a one-time, provided we amortize over the 12-month commit in the agreement (we should avoid front-loading revenue recognition).
- Rev-share carveout for reseller: OK for pilot if we: 
  1) limit the carveout to the first 6 months and cap the total payout at $60k (protects margin) OR
  2) accept uncapped payout only if CloudBright guarantees >$250k ARR committed to marketplace listing within 6 months (performance milestone)
- SLA credit: do not accept open-ended credits tied to latency without runbook. Suggest a remediation playbook instead + 1% credit cap for the pilot.

If Finance (Evelyn) signs off on the DSO impact and Rev Ops confirms payout automation, I'm comfortable with escalating to the Executive approvers for a one-off exception.

I'm attaching a short note with estimated margin delta by scenario (see revshare_model.xlsx).

-Karthik
VP, Strategic Accounts

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-20T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: marketplace one-off concession for CloudBright — Net75 billing & revised rev-share

Looping to align on approvals + ask for Exec note: 

Monica, please confirm the commercial ask to the customer in writing (email thread with final bullets) so Legal has a clear set of requests to redline. For internal approvers, we'll need the following packaged: 

- Final term sheet PDF with the concession highlighted (customer-signed email acceptable)
- Finance signoff on DSO and how the $45k credit will be recorded (amortization schedule)
- Rev Ops confirmation on partner payout mechanism and payment cap (if any)
- Executive signoff request email (I can draft to the CCO/CFO once we have finance note)

I recommend we keep the cap option (Karthik's #1) as our default ask to the customer to avoid open-ended liability. If CloudBright pushes back, we can surface the milestone path.

-Marissa
Head of Deal Desk

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-21T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: marketplace one-off concession for CloudBright — Net75 billing & revised rev-share

Reviewed the revshare_model.xlsx and CloudBright term summary. Finance sign-off (conditional): 

Conditions for approval:
1) Net75 approved for this account only and for the period of the 12-month contract; Collections team to set an auto-alert on day 60 and weekly follow-up cadence once past 75 days.
2) $45k onboarding credit to be amortized over 12 months for revenue recognition. No revenue kicker prior to month 3.
3) Rev-share carveout: approve Karthik's option #1 — partner payout capped at $60k for the first 6 months. If CloudBright signs a written confirmation that they will commit >$250k ARR to the marketplace within 6 months, we will remove the cap (requirement must be in the MDP).
4) SLA credit: replace open credit with a documented remediation playbook and a maximum of 1% service credit for the pilot (1% cap).
5) Require signed DocuSign of the redlined MDP before the listing goes live (Legal to prepare).

I'll approve the exception with the above conditions. Marissa — please draft the executive approval email to the CCO and include these conditions verbatim. Karthik/Monica — once Legal returns the redline, route to me for final countersign.

Attachments referenced: Redwood_MDP_draft_for_CloudBright.pdf (please ensure Legal adds the milestone clause)

Regards,
Evelyn Hart
VP Finance, Revenue Operations
